verdict.rationale: Godot exposes a documented, scriptable surface (command-line/headless mode, EditorScript for in-editor automation, full GDScript/C# class API, and a keyless JSON Asset Library API) that an agent could drive programmatically, per godot-docs-3/5/12/14 and godot-probe-rt-1/2. However this is a traditional engine API/CLI, not an AI-native interface: probes confirm no llms.txt, no OpenAPI spec, and no official MCP server (godot-probe-1/2/3, godot-probe-rt-3), leaving only third-party community MCP wrappers of uneven maintenance. Missing for 10: an official machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt) and a first-party MCP or agent-oriented interface layer.
